name: Tag
description: Compact eyebrow-style label chip on a subtle surface. Used for category labels and metadata badges.

notes: Rendered as a static span — purely presentational text, no interactive semantics.
content/label on background/subtle meets WCAG 1.4.3 contrast in both themes.
If used to convey status alone, pair with visible text elsewhere — color/shape must not be the only signal.
Figma binds padding/radius to primitives (spacing-4/8, radius-4); CSS uses the semantic equivalents --s2a-spacing-2xs/-xs and --s2a-border-radius-2xs which resolve to the same values.
Single-variant set in Figma (State=Default) — no data-attribute variants needed yet.
